Layout geo lataxis objects

Source: R/zz-gen-layout.R
go_geo_lataxis.Rd

The object for the layout's geo.lataxis (go_geo()). go_geo_lataxis() creates one, with exactly its properties; a named list with the same properties works too.

Usage

go_geo_lataxis(
  ...,
  dtick = NULL,
  gridcolor = NULL,
  griddash = NULL,
  gridwidth = NULL,
  range = NULL,
  showgrid = NULL,
  tick0 = NULL,
  skip_invalid = FALSE
)

Arguments

...

Not for properties, which must be named in full: an abbreviated or unknown name is an error that suggests the right one.

dtick

Sets the graticule's longitude/latitude tick step. Number.

gridcolor

Sets the graticule's stroke color. Color: a CSS color string or R color name.

griddash

Sets the dash style of lines. Set to a dash type string ("solid", "dot", "dash", "longdash", "dashdot", or "longdashdot") or a dash length list in px (eg "5px,10px,2px,2px"). One of "solid", "dot", "dash", "longdash", "dashdot", "longdashdot", or a string matching "^\\d+(\\.\\d+)?(px|%)?((,|\\s)\\s*\\d+(\\.\\d+)?(px|%)?)*$".

gridwidth

Sets the graticule's stroke width (in px). Number in the interval [0, Inf].

range

Sets the range of this axis (in degrees), sets the map's clipped coordinates. Vector or list of 2 element(s).

showgrid

Sets whether or not graticule are shown on the map. Logical.

tick0

Sets the graticule's starting tick longitude/latitude. Number.

skip_invalid

If TRUE, silently drop invalid properties instead of raising an error.

Value

A go_layout_geo_lataxis object (a named list).

Details

Nested objects are named lists, or objects of the constructors their arguments name. Every property is checked against the plotly.js schema when the object is created or modified. A property may be a one-sided formula (color = ~col): it is kept, and evaluated in the data (then checked) when its trace is added to a figure with add_<trace>() or add_trace().

Examples

quakes |>
  go_figure() |>
  add_scattergeo(lat = ~lat, lon = ~long) |>
  update_layout(geo = go_geo(lataxis = go_geo_lataxis()))
